name: ap2
title: AP2
role: Authorization method, not a payment rail: a paid resource can require a verified mandate in addition to its x402 or MPP payment, never instead of it.
subset: closed Checkout Mandate verification before settlement

spec.statement: Standardization of the specification will continue within the Agentic Authentication Technical and Payments Technical Working Groups in FIDO

exclusions.name: open checkout mandates (mandate.checkout.open.1)
exclusions.note: Rejected because the provider does not evaluate spending constraints.

exclusions.name: JWKS and any key discovery by URL (jku, x5u)
exclusions.note: Operators supply all keys in config.

exclusions.name: key rotation without a config change
AP2 transport adapter or /.well-known/ap2
exclusions.note: HTTP, MCP and A2A carry the mandate in the gateway's own carriers; AP2 v0.2.0 defines none.

exclusions.name: AP2 over the ACP checkout adapter

conformance.suite: Tests using mandates minted by the AP2 v0.2.0 reference SDK, plus end-to-end refusal cases.

gaps.requirement: Return a Checkout Receipt once the merchant has accepted or rejected a Checkout Mandate
